metadata.method_name: TP-G: ten-algorithm grid manifold with and without names (iteration 9)
metadata.description: Qwen3-32B nf4 (truncated decoder) and Qwen3-8B bf16 activation manifolds of 10 path-search algorithms from alias prompts (M-name), name-free descriptions (M-desc), alias-minus-twin deltas (M-lex) and name-scrubbed programs (M-code); landing of iteration 8's survivors; lexical regression; RSA against lexical/behavioural/surface RDMs; per-program placement.

n4_verdict.statement: The geometry is correlational: it describes where representations and survivors sit, not whether the model uses this geometry to choose an algorithm (iteration 7's in-manifold pushes moved 0/300).

deviations.text: M-name reproduction rho=0.894 (0.85-0.95: proceed with new states)

M-code sets use tier-B acceptance (mechanism labels + committed AST rules + trace check + valid paths on >= 38/40 probe grids) instead of the two hidden suites, for every source and algorithm alike: under tier A (committed ACCEPT) 4 of 5 non-banned classes have < 10 programs, mostly IDDFS/IDA*-style timeouts on the 30x30 hidden cases; tier-A counts are reported in results/acceptance.json
19/40 labeller disagreements for S1 bibfs (excluded; no manual adjudication within the time box)
13/40 labeller disagreements for S1 dijkstra_unit (excluded; no manual adjudication within the time box)
33/50 labeller disagreements for S1 idastar (excluded; no manual adjudication within the time box)
25/50 labeller disagreements for S1 jps (excluded; no manual adjudication within the time box)
36/50 labeller disagreements for S1 biastar (excluded; no manual adjudication within the time box)
36/60 labeller disagreements for S2 bibfs (excluded; no manual adjudication within the time box)
32/60 labeller disagreements for S2 idastar (excluded; no manual adjudication within the time box)
36/60 labeller disagreements for S2 jps (excluded; no manual adjudication within the time box)
44/60 labeller disagreements for S2 biastar (excluded; no manual adjudication within the time box)

G-scrub re-run before any M-code state: the first run required tier-B programs to pass the hidden suites after scrubbing (they were never required to pass them); the check is now 'suites outcome unchanged' (placement SURV/BASE still must pass); the code-span check counts boundary-straddling tokens; commit COMMIT1b-r1

analysis restricted to the 32B manifolds M-name, M-desc, M-lex, M-code PRIMARY R1/R2 and the Qwen3-32B-only M-code frame, and to M-name, M-desc, M-code R1 on Qwen3-8B; dropped for time: M8 frame, R1g and R3 readouts, Qwen3-8B M-lex (their states are kept in cache/states)

import heapq

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    if not grid or not grid[0]:
        return []
    rows, cols = (len(grid), len(grid[0]))
    start_row, start_col = start
    goal_row, goal_col = goal
    if start_row < 0 or start_row >= rows or start_col < 0 or (start_col >= cols) or (grid[start_row][start_col] == '#') or (grid[goal_row][goal_col] == '#'):
        return []
    if start == goal:
        return [start]
    directions = [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]
    pq = [(0, start_row, start_col, [start])]
    visited = set()
    visited.add((start_row, start_col))
    while pq:
